subject.title: [Feature]: 内置健壮性机制：Watchdog、全局错误处理、自动恢复

question: Should OpenClaw core own a built-in Gateway watchdog and recovery ladder, and which recovery actions should be default, opt-in, or explicitly out of scope?
rationale: The request adds core recovery semantics, config surface, operator notifications, and possible repair/state mutation behavior that source inspection cannot choose safely without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep as design umbrella
options.body: Use this issue to hold the maintainer-approved core design while narrower PRs and issues cover watchdog infrastructure, health probes, doctor repair, and crash-ladder slices.

options.title: Split and close after canonicalization
options.body: Move each remaining behavior into a specific canonical issue and close this only once the umbrella context is preserved there.

options.title: Reject core ownership
options.body: Decide that process recovery should stay in external supervisor/plugin/ClawHub tooling and document the supported external pattern instead of adding core watchdog semantics.

recommendation.title: Keep as design umbrella
recommendation.body: Use this issue to hold the maintainer-approved core design while narrower PRs and issues cover watchdog infrastructure, health probes, doctor repair, and crash-ladder slices.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history across restart, Gateway health, and docs surfaces involved in the design choice.
